redesigns.title: Shaded rest ledges for the stepwell landing
redesigns.description: Stone ledges and a light canopy so people can sit out of the sun without blocking the steps.

redesigns.title: Chowk steps as evening seating
redesigns.description: Widened treads, a handrail and low lighting for the hours when the chowk is busiest.

redesigns.title: Courtyard water channel and jaali screen
redesigns.description: Brings back a shallow water channel and adds a screen for shade and privacy.

redesigns.title: Threshold benches and drinking water point
redesigns.description: Two benches inside the gate and a public water point for people waiting.

redesigns.title: Stepwell handrail and night lighting
redesigns.description: A continuous handrail and shielded lights along the main descent.

redesigns.title: Shade sails over the haveli courtyard
redesigns.description: Two tensioned sails anchored to the existing parapets, with a ground-level bench along the north wall.

contests.title: A shared courtyard for Chandpole lane
contests.brief: Residents voted this courtyard their top priority. Propose a low-cost redesign that keeps it open to the lane, adds shade and seating, and can be built in phases.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students
criteria: Responds to what residents asked for

contests.title: Evening seating for the Badi Chaupar steps
contests.brief: The chowk steps fill up every evening, but there is nowhere to sit that is not a step. Propose seating and lighting that work with the bazaar, not against it.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students
criteria: Keeps the steps open for passing through
Lighting that is safe and not glaring

contests.title: Stepwell terrace, Nahargarh foothill
contests.brief: Make the terrace safe and usable after dark without changing the stepwell itself.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students

contests.title: Plinth steps that drain in the monsoon
contests.brief: Water pools on the temple plinth steps for weeks every monsoon. Propose a fix for drainage that keeps the steps usable for sitting and selling.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students
criteria: Drains within an hour of heavy rain
Can be built in the dry season

contests.title: A place to wait at Jaipur Darwaza
contests.brief: People wait inside the gateway for buses with nowhere to sit and no water. Design benches and a water point that leave the arch clear for traffic on foot.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students
criteria: Drinking water that is easy to maintain

entries.title: Threshold shade
entries.statement: A perforated stone canopy over the waiting ledge, with a drinking-water point set into the arch wall.

plans.text: Winner announced; the co-host bought the design.
Design development with the architect and people who wait here.
Construction of the benches and the water point.
Opening, then a follow-up survey on the platform.

contests.title: Shade for the Amer Road stepwell landing
contests.brief: The landing is unusable in May and June. Propose shade that can go up in a season and does not hide the stepwell.
contests.eligibility: Licensed architects and accredited architecture students

plans.text: Winner announced; the co-host bought the design.
Canopy built by the residents’ association.
Check-in with residents on how the shade is working.
